name: Takigawa Tsubasa
source:
Producing what are best described as lighthearted stories, Tsubasa was part of another doujinshi circle until they kicked her out. The protagonist, having seen her work at earlier conventions, quickly bolsters her confidence to continue and offers recruitment. Tsubasa is seemingly plagued by the quality of what inspires her works, rather than the work itself, as her art skill is of professional level.

[edited from [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20070211064835/www.elizar.com/?p=7]Nargrakhan's review[/url]]
